mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, store_id AS storeId, biz_date AS bizDate FROM analysis_refresh_queue ORDER BY requested_at, tenant_id, store_id, biz_date LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM analysis_store_daily WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND store_id = #{storeId} AND biz_date = #{bizDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_store_daily (tenant_id, biz_date, store_id, gross_sales_amount, net_sales_amount, discount_amount, valid_order_count, sales_quantity, updated_at) SELECT ro.tenant_id, #{bizDate}, ro.store_id, COALESCE(SUM(ro.total_amount), 0), COALESCE(SUM(ro.actual_amount), 0), COALESCE(SUM(ro.discount_amount), 0), COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM restaurant_order_item roi WHERE roi.tenant_id = ro.tenant_id AND roi.order_id = ro.id )), 0), NOW() FROM restaurant_order ro WHERE ro.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ro.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro.payment_status IN (1, 2) AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.payment_time >= CONCAT(#{bizDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND ro.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{bizDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY ro.tenant_id, ro.store_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM analysis_store_dish_daily WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND store_id = #{storeId} AND biz_date = #{bizDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_store_dish_daily (tenant_id, biz_date, store_id, dish_id, category_id, sales_quantity, gross_sales_amount, net_sales_amount, cost_amount, gross_profit_amount, order_count, gift_quantity, unknown_cost_quantity, updated_at) SELECT ro.tenant_id, #{bizDate}, ro.store_id, roi.dish_id, COALESCE(roi.category_id, 0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN roi.unit_list_price * roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 AND oit.item_payable_amount > 0 THEN roi.line_payable_amount * ro.actual_amount / oit.item_payable_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), SUM(roi.line_cost_amount), CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN roi.unit_cost_snapshot IS NULL THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 AND oit.item_payable_amount > 0 THEN roi.line_payable_amount * ro.actual_amount / oit.item_payable_amount ELSE 0 END - COALESCE(roi.line_cost_amount, 0)), 0) ELSE NULL END, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN ro.id END), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN roi.is_gift = 1 THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN roi.unit_cost_snapshot IS NULL THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0), NOW() FROM restaurant_order ro INNER JOIN restaurant_order_item roi ON roi.tenant_id = ro.tenant_id AND roi.order_id = ro.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, order_id, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN line_payable_amount ELSE 0 END) AS item_payable_amount FROM restaurant_order_item GROUP BY tenant_id, order_id ) oit ON oit.tenant_id = ro.tenant_id AND oit.order_id = ro.id WHERE ro.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ro.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro.payment_status IN (1, 2) AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.payment_time >= CONCAT(#{bizDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND ro.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{bizDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY ro.tenant_id, ro.store_id, roi.dish_id, COALESCE(roi.category_id, 0)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM analysis_refresh_queue WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND store_id = #{storeId} AND biz_date = #{bizDate}
